title: AI Gateway logs filter shape is wrong: metadata.run_id is not a valid key
description:
Found by a LIVE cloud run, and it is the concern k2s itself flagged as unverified ("the AI Gateway logs API query shape"). Two real runs failed on it:

  run_665216641434494d81e07a7ec7220551 — no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN configured (fixed by setting the secret)
  run_b66d8db41a9e4405b5729a8f64017b47 — "the AI Gateway logs API answered 400"

Reproduced against the real API and the cause is exact. cloud/factory/src/gateway.ts:544 builds:
  [{"key":"metadata.run_id","operator":"eq","value":[runID]}]
and the API rejects it:
  7001 Invalid enum value. Expected id | created_at | ... | metadata.key | metadata.value | ... , received "metadata.run_id"

The API models metadata as two separate filters, not a dotted key. VERIFIED WORKING shape (HTTP 200 against the operator account):
  [{"key":"metadata.key","operator":"eq","value":["run_id"]},
   {"key":"metadata.value","operator":"eq","value":["<run id>"]}]

Fix that query. While there, check the same assumption anywhere else metadata is queried (tick attribution as well as run attribution), and add a test that pins the filter shape against the documented enum so a future API change fails loudly rather than as a 400 swallowed into "cost unknown".

Note the failure mode this produced is CORRECT behaviour from jk7: a configured cost budget that cannot be enforced refuses the run before booting a sandbox. That guard is doing its job — the query underneath it is what is broken.
acceptance_criteria: A run with a configured cost budget reads its gateway telemetry and proceeds to boot a sandbox; the filter shape is pinned by a test; querying an unknown metadata key fails loudly rather than being swallowed.
